entries.source: Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 7 = Continuatio 3
entries.latin: Ebirhardus de Rosenberg miles et advocatus in Durne testatur se una cum Heinrico Bavaro notario domini Moguntini et aliis amicis ejus in die placiti ex parte domini Moguntini cum Ruperto duce Bawariae in Bensheim 30 solidos hallenses expendisse per Jacobum cellerarium in Starkenberg solvendos. D. Benzheim feria tertia post diem decollationis Joh. Baptistae. *Ego EBIRHARDUS de Rofenberg miles, Advocatus in Durne, recognofco publice in hiis fcriptis, quod ego una cum HEINRICO Bawar. Notario Domini mei Moguntini & aliis amicis ejusdem mei Domini, feria tercia poft diem decollacionis beati Johannis baptifte, cum diem placiti ex parte dicti Domini Moguntini cum amicis illuftris Principis Domini RUPERTI Ducis Bawa-rie in Bensheim tenuimus, triginta folidos hall. expendimus, quam pecuniam JACOBUS Cellerarius in Starkenberg pro nobis folvere tenetur. Datum Bensheim feria tercia predicta. Anno Domini MCCCXLII.*
entries.english: Eberhard von Rosenberg, knight and advocate in Dürn, testifies that he, together with Heinrich Bavar, notary of the lord of Mainz, and his other friends, on the day of the hearing on behalf of the lord of Mainz with Ruprecht, duke of Bavaria, in Bensheim, had spent 30 Hallenses shillings, to be paid by Jacob, the cellarer in Starkenberg. Given at Bensheim on the Tuesday after the day of the beheading of John the Baptist.

entries.german: Ritter Ebirh[ard] von Rosenberg, Vogt in Dürn (Durne), bekundet, daß er am Tag des Schreibens mit dem Notar des Erzbischofs von Mainz, Heinrich Bavarus, und anderen Freunden des Erzbischofs bei einer Tagung mit Freunden des Pfalzgrafen Ruprecht in Bensheim (cum diem placiti ex parte dicti domini Mog. cum amicis .. d. Ruperti, ducis Bavarie, in B. tenuimus) 30 sol. Heller ausgegeben habe, die der Kellerer Jakob in Starkenburg[1] für Eberhard zu zahlen hat (tenetur). D. Bensheim fer. III. post diem decollationis b. Johannis Baptiste. Fußnotenapparat: [1] Er wird in der Aschaffenburger Kellereirechnung 1341/42 erwähnt zum 25. Nov. 1342: Preterea recepi de Schauwenburg, de Heppenheym et de Bensheym a Jacobo cellerario in Starkinberg fer. II. ipsa die Ste Kathrine virginis 32 carratas vini veteris in 36 vasis.
entries.abstract: The knight Eberhard von Rosenberg, vogt in Dürn, instructs the cellar Jakob zu Starkenburg (Starkenberg) to pay the costs incurred during the meeting with the Bavarian envoys of Count Palatine Rupert I in Bensheim.
entries.english: The knight Eberhard von Rosenberg, Vogt in Dürn, states that on the date of the document he spent 30 Heller shillings at a meeting in Bensheim with friends of Count Palatine Ruprecht, together with Heinrich Bavarus, notary of the Archbishop of Mainz, and other friends of the archbishop. Jakob, the cellarer in Starkenburg, is to pay the expense. Given at Bensheim on the Tuesday after the beheading of John the Baptist.
